title: Release & packaging phase
preamble:
You are one engineer on a team delivering a multi-issue epic in this TypeScript monorepo (pnpm workspaces + vitest, 4 packages under packages/). Issues are delivered sequentially by different engineers, one issue per session.

IMPORTANT: earlier issues in this epic may have already landed code in this repository. Modules, helpers and conventions introduced by those issues are part of this codebase now. Before you implement anything, read the surrounding code and reuse what is already there rather than re-inventing it or duplicating it. You will not be shown the other issues.

Ground rules for every issue in this epic:
- The full suite is green when your session starts. Verify your work with: pnpm -s build && pnpm -s test
- `pnpm -s test` does NOT typecheck. `pnpm -s build` does, including test files. Both must pass.
- All relative imports need explicit `.js` extensions (Node16 module resolution).
- The compiler runs with `strict`, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` and `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`. Follow how neighboring code satisfies these (e.g. `foo?: string | undefined`).
- Keep changes minimal and idiomatic; follow the conventions of neighboring code.
- Updating an existing test is allowed ONLY where your change legitimately alters what it sets up or asserts. Never weaken an unrelated assertion, and never change a test to match a result you did not intend.
- Add tests for new behavior at the depth neighboring tests use.

When done, summarize your change briefly.
